summary: Henkel is multinational chemical and consumer goods company headquartered in Germany, founded in 1876. Type: listed company. About 48,900 employees (Wikidata). Revenue Q4916 19.2 billion (2020). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 5 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 4 about funding; 17 about acquisitions; 7 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: German maker of Persil, Schwarzkopf and Loctite; IND sponsor posting English-language internships in Amsterdam, Utrecht and Scheemda.

culture.text: About 50,000 employees of 125 nationalities in 75 countries, with 43% women across management levels.
Employee reviews on its site praise growth and global exposure, though one notes often working during leave.
Staff often studied business, marketing, chemistry or chemical engineering.

open.text: Henkel Nederland, Henkel Nederland Operations and Henkel Global Supply Chain B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
All 5 jobs here are internships open to non-Dutch speakers, drawing about 109 LinkedIn applicants on average.

growth.text: Staff fell from 52,600 in 2020 to 48,900 in 2023.
Completed its €2.1 billion acquisition of Netherlands-based specialty coatings maker Stahl.

worth_knowing.text: Henkel is celebrating 150 years since its founding in 1876.
